rows.label: Preset
rows.description: Auto picks Performance on Steam Deck, on battery, on integrated graphics, or with 8 or fewer CPU threads. Otherwise it picks Quality. Changing a preset option switches this to Custom.

rows.label: Frame Rate

options.planned: After U5 · variable refresh or a fixed frame pattern
After U5 · variable refresh or a fixed frame pattern

rows.description: The game always runs at full speed — this only changes smoothness. On most displays, 30 or 60 looks smoother than 40 or 50.

rows.label: Render Scale
rows.description: Draws the 3D world at a different resolution than your screen. Below 100% is faster; 150% and 200% are sharper but much heavier. Auto adjusts on the fly to hold 60 fps. The HUD always stays sharp.

rows.label: Upscaler
rows.description: How a lowered render scale is scaled back up to your screen. Only used when Render Scale is below 100%. FSR 3 needs a desktop GPU.

rows.label: Frame Generation

options.planned: Uses your own Lossless Scaling copy
Uses your own Lossless Scaling copy
Uses your own Lossless Scaling copy

rows.description: Smoother motion from generated in-between frames. FSR 3 needs the FSR 3 upscaler and a display at twice the frame rate. Adds about one refresh of input lag.

rows.label: Anisotropic Filtering
rows.description: Keeps textures sharp at steep angles, like the ground ahead of you.

rows.label: FXAA
rows.description: Smooths jagged edges for a small cost. Can soften fine detail.

rows.label: Ambient Occlusion
rows.description: Soft shading where surfaces meet, like under ledges and in corners.

rows.label: Display
rows.description: Play in a window or fill the whole screen.

rows.label: Resolution
rows.description: The resolution the game outputs. 1280 × 800 matches Steam Deck.

rows.label: Aspect Ratio
rows.description: Auto fills your screen, including ultrawide 21:9 and 32:9. The HUD stays pinned to the picture’s corners. On a widescreen, 4:3 adds bars at the sides.

rows.label: V-Sync
rows.description: Syncs frames to your display to stop screen tearing. Can add a little input lag.

rows.label: Variable Refresh
rows.description: For FreeSync, G-Sync and other VRR displays. Turn VRR on in your monitor and desktop settings too. Usually works in fullscreen only.

rows.label: FPS Overlay
rows.description: Shows the frame rate in a corner. Frame time shows how long each frame took — handy for spotting stutter.

rows.label: CPU Threads
rows.description: How many threads run the game’s three console CPU cores. 3 is fastest.

rows.label: Lazy DrawDone
rows.description: A speed option for slower GPUs.

settingsCategories.name: Diagnostics
settingsCategories.note: Developer switches; can be hidden in release builds.

rows.label: Texture Write-Watch
rows.description: Developer speed switch. Leave it on unless you’re testing.

rows.label: Vertex De-duplication
rows.description: Developer speed switch. Leave it on unless you’re testing.

rows.label: Surface Fit
rows.description: Developer speed switch. Leave it on unless you’re testing.

rows.label: GPU Barriers
rows.description: Developer speed switch. Leave it on unless you’re testing.

rows.label: Clears as Load Ops
rows.description: Developer speed switch. Leave it on unless you’re testing.

rows.label: Keep Game Speed
rows.description: Keeps the game at full speed when frames drop. Turning it off is for testing only and writes a warning to the log.

rows.label: Motion Vectors & Jitter
rows.description: Extra data FSR 3 needs. Switched on automatically whenever the FSR 3 upscaler is in use.

rows.label: Swift Sail
rows.description: Sail at double speed, and the wind always blows your way.

rows.label: Text Speed
rows.description: How quickly dialogue text appears.

rows.label: Quick Conducting
rows.description: Songs you already know play instantly instead of being conducted beat by beat.

rows.label: Short Item Fanfares
rows.description: Shortens the item-get sequence for rupees, hearts and repeat pickups.

rows.label: Target Lock Style
rows.description: Hold to keep the lock, or press once to lock and again to release.

rows.label: Hero Mode
rows.description: Enemies deal double damage and hearts never drop. Can be switched off at any time.
